title: Inside the backrooms blocks
description: A Minecraft mod that adds blocks for backroom-style buildings
body:
This mod adds blocks for backroom style buildings.The mod includes blocks for three-dimensional buildings.Items are also present.A version for working with bedrock may be added in the future.The mod adds only blocks without worlds.The mod contains blocks with custom models.

**All blocks and items**

Wallpaper,Concreteceiling,lamp,carpet,wallpaperarrow, backrooms concrete1,backrooms concrete2,backrooms concrete3,treshold,corner,almond water,pool tiles,pool steps,ERROR,darkness,realistic grass,concrete(level188),wooden floor,table,pool tile column,wet carpet,torn wallpaper,realistic glass,realistic glass panels.
